# DeepSeek Balance — DSH plugin
Português | **English**

Shows the money balance of your DeepSeek account in the left sidebar, **right
above the "More" butto

s the money balance of your DeepSeek account in the left sidebar, **right
above the "More" button**.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What it does

- Reads the balance from `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` using the
same `DEEPSEEK_API_KE

Y` credential the DSH `deepseek-official` provider uses.
- Shows the **total balance** (topped up +

granted) in the currency returned by
the API (usually `USD`), formatted with the browser locale.
- R

efreshes itself every 60 seconds while the window is visible.
- **Click the row** to force a fresh r

ead (bypasses the 30 s host cache).
- Hover for details: granted, topped up, last read time and a us

age hint.
- On failure it shows `—` with the reason in the tooltip:
- `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` missing fro

t;
- balance below the minimum for new requests (value in warning color).
## Requirements

- DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (tested on that version; it uses the client slot API and the
authenticated harness

Connection).
- `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` configured — on DSH's **Models** page or as an environment
variabl

e of the process that starts the app.
- No third-party dependencies and no install scripts.
## Install
Clone this repository and install the package folder:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
With DSH open, ask the agent:
> install the plugin from the folder `C:\path\to\clone`

`plugin_manager` accepts the absolute path of the package. After installing, the
row appears on its
own; no restart is needed on the first install.

Repository and issues:
<https://github.com/Brunojomosi/dsh-plugin-deepseek-saldo>
## Privacy and security

- The only external address is `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`.
- The key stays inside the h

ost process: the page receives only the number,
currency and timestamp, through an authenticated DSH

Connection route
(`/api/deepseek-balance/state`).
- No telemetry, no file writes, no cookies/localS

torage reads, no command
execution.
## Layout
| File | Role |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: registers the authenticated Connection route and calls the DeepSeek AP

I. |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: registers the row in `sidebar.footer.action` (the space right

above the account menu). |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `deepseek-balance` entry into the pro

file Loader. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Title and description shown in Settings → Plug

ins. |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon in the plugin list. |
## Where it lives and how to remove

DSH installs the package as a *link* to a folder on your computer, so that folder
must keep existing
. A common choice is:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Keep the folder out of `Downloads` and out of the app installation folder, so
cleanups and DSH updat
es cannot affect the plugin.

To remove: Settings → Plugins → DeepSeek Balance → uninstall (or
`plugin_manager` with `remove_bundl

e`). Restart the app if the removal asks for
it.

> **Reinstalling:** the browser module id is `dsh-plugin-deepseek-saldo`. If you
> remove and reinst

all this same package, DSH may cache the old module as
> "absent" and the row only comes back after

restarting the app — that is
> harness behavior, not the plugin.
## Limitations

- Only visible with the sidebar expanded; in the 56 px rail the row is hidden.
- The balance is the

**API account** balance (`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`). If the key is
changed in the environment, the next cyc

le reads the new balance.
- The currency comes from the API and is limited to **CNY or USD**; when b

oth
wallets exist, the row shows **USD** first and the other currency in the
tooltip. Other currenci
es are not provided and there is no conversion.
